description.en:
I just saw a glowing orb UFO zip across the sky. It caught my eye, I looked up, saw it for just over 2 seconds before it disappeared behind tree line.

It was very bright, light yellow in the middle with orange border (like a fire ember), seemed perfectly round, had no "tail" like a meteor usually does, had the speed of a meteor and was very bright like a meteor fireball would be but again there was no tail or trail.

Est 7:45pm PT, Mission Viejo, CA, southern sky, object moved west to east.

The observer's own words agree without giving a figure: "far less star visible due to surrounding light pollution" (reply on X, 2026-09-29)
